strike.name: Strike
strike.desc: A solid blow to an enemy in the front row.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.desc: Hit a front-row enemy and shove it back one tile.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Aimed enemy attacks (single, cross, pair) are redirected onto you this round.

rampart.name: Rampart
rampart.desc: Everyone in your lane takes half damage this round.

jab.name: Jab
jab.desc: Quick thrust at an enemy in the front or middle row.

hook.name: Hook
hook.desc: Throw a chain down your lane. Pulls the first thing it hits one tile toward you.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.desc: Pierce an enemy and the tile behind it.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.desc: Hit the whole enemy front row and push it back.

shunt.name: Shunt
shunt.desc: Shove a front/middle enemy one lane up or down.

firebolt.name: Firebolt
firebolt.desc: Bolt down your lane. Hits the first unit in the way, ally or not.

flame_pillar.name: Flame Pillar
flame_pillar.desc: Burn every lane at one depth.

scorch.name: Scorch
scorch.desc: Set any enemy tile ablaze for 3 rounds.

detonate.name: Detonate
detonate.desc: Explosion in a cross. Only from the back row.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: A small bolt of raw force at any enemy. Weak, but nothing is immune to it.

daze.name: Daze
daze.desc: Stun: cancels this round's action and the next.

ward.name: Ward
ward.desc: An ally takes half damage this round.

transpose.name: Transpose
transpose.desc: Swap an enemy with whatever is in the lane above or below it.

aimed_shot.name: Aimed Shot
aimed_shot.desc: Pick off any enemy, over the heads of the front line. Back row only.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.desc: Scatter spikes on any enemy tile for 3 rounds. Mobile enemies avoid them.

arrow_rain.name: Arrow Rain
arrow_rain.desc: Arrows fall on an entire enemy lane.

pinning_shot.name: Pinning Shot
pinning_shot.desc: Pin an enemy in place: stuns it this round and next. Back row only.

flame_lunge.name: Flame Lunge
flame_lunge.desc: A burning thrust through an enemy and the tile behind it.

searing_hook.name: Searing Hook
searing_hook.desc: A white-hot chain down your lane. Burns and pulls the first thing it hits.

blazing_sweep.name: Blazing Sweep
blazing_sweep.desc: Fire across the whole enemy front row, driving it back.

slam.name: Slam
slam.desc: Charges down its lane into the first thing in the way.

flicker.name: Flicker
flicker.desc: A darting flame at one tile.

quake.name: Quake
quake.desc: The ground heaves along one whole depth.

crush.name: Crush
crush.desc: A crushing fist at the front row.

arrow.name: Arrow
arrow.desc: Shoots down its lane. Hits the first thing in the way, friend or foe.

volley.name: Volley
volley.desc: Arrows rain on an entire lane.
